Aditya / Karthik —

Forwarding Helix's asks. Summary of nonstandard items: H120 as primary reserved accelerator (nonstandard SKU for Dedicated), transient burst allowance to H100 up to 600 GPU-hrs/mo with a hard overage cap request at $42/hr, and a 15% discount on committed units year 1. This is a mid-enterprise deal, HS record HS-484321, potential ARR impact significant but precedent-setting if we approve the H120 primary.

We have the following internal constraints to weigh: inventory for H120 is limited in our us-west region (see JIRA:INFR-1279), H100 burst capacity is available but would require a reservation-hold window and possible cross-region fallback. Pricing team flagged that $42/hr is below our modeled overage floor for H100 by ~18%.

As deal desk, I recommend one of these approaches:
- Option A (conservative): Approve H120 reservation only; deny the fixed $42/hr cap but offer variable overage based on actual mix (estimate $50-58/hr) and provide a temporary burst hold of 90 days during the launch at our standard overage rates.
- Option B (growth-accented): Approve H120 reserved + temporary one-quarter concession on overage to $45/hr (with a strict 600 GPU-hr cap and a surcharge if exceeded), and grant a 10% platform discount (instead of 15%) for first 12 months; require DocuSign amendment and finance signoff.

Requesting executive signoff on Option B if we want to keep momentum. If you prefer, we can present a counter-offer to Helix with a promise to re-evaluate after the pilot.

Please reply with approval or edits — Helix is ready to proceed this week.

Thanks,
Laura
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Laura / team —

Thanks for the summary and the options. I agree with taking a measured concession to keep the sale moving but protect our economics. Approve Option B with the following required guardrails:
- Approve H120 as primary reserved accelerator for the committed term (24 months) provided Helix accepts a 2.5% uplift to start-of-term pricing to cover inventory premium.
- Approve temporary overage concession to $45/GPU-hr for up to 600 GPU-hrs/mo for the first 3 billing cycles only. After 3 cycles, auto-revert to our standard H100 overage pricing. Include a clause that any usage above 600 GPU-hrs/mo will be billed at our standard overage + 25% surcharge (to discourage sustained bursting).
- Approve a 10% platform discount on committed units for months 1-12 only; discount document must be captured in the DocuSign amendment and Finance must sign off before provisioning.
- Require a reservation-hold window of 21 days where we reserve H100 capacity for Helix's burst during go-live period; if they do not provision within 21 days, the transient hold is released.

Karthik / Marissa: please draft the amendment language and the short-term billing rule set (JIRA:INFR-1279) and confirm inventory availability in us-west and us-east. Finance: confirm acceptance of a 10% discount and the temporary $45/hr overage concession with the 3-cycle reversion.

Aditya
Head of Sales Operations
